title: 连续尺寸 L 形装入正方形
titleEn: Consecutive L shapes in a square

knownBest.source: The largest L contains an n × 2n rectangle. At every angle at least one coordinate projection is at least 2n, so the container side is at least 2n. One L attains this directly; for n=2 the small L fits inside the large L’s 2×2 notch, attaining side 4.
